name: Petronas Twin Towers
desc: Twin steel rockets tied together with a skybridge. Stand below at night for free and feel very, very small in the best way.

name: Batu Caves
desc: 272 rainbow steps up to a cave temple, guarded by a golden giant and monkeys with zero manners. Free, but bring leg-day energy.

name: KL Tower
desc: The other tower — arguably the better view, because this skyline includes the Petronas. The sunset slot is the move.

name: Merdeka Square
desc: Where independence was declared under a 95-metre flagpole. A free lap of history past the fanciest old buildings in town.

name: Petaling Street Market
desc: Chinatown's covered bazaar — haggling is the cardio, the snack stalls are the reward. Entry free, willpower extra.

name: KLCC Park
desc: Manicured lawns with a fountain show dancing under the twin towers every night. Free front-row seats to a light symphony.

name: Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia
desc: Domes, calligraphy and miniature mosques in a serene white building. A few bucks buys some of the calmest beauty in the city.

name: Thean Hou Temple
desc: Six tiers of red lanterns and dragons on a hilltop. Free, glowing, and basically built for your someday photo album.

name: Jalan Alor Food Street
desc: One street, a hundred woks, all fired up after dark. Come broke, leave full — this is KL's real night show.

name: Perdana Botanical Gardens
desc: KL's oldest garden — lakes, hibiscus and shade for days. The city's free reset button since 1888.
